purpose: One integration map for Foundation across ontology, domain schemas, graph, Rooms, Timeline, archive and public readers.
query_examples: Which current institutions have been refounded more than once?
Show systems where authorization and first operation were separated by years.
Which foundations reproduce primarily through pedagogy rather than law?
Which current rules descend from a superseded foundation?
Which branches claim continuity with the same F0 but use different reproduction mechanisms?
Where did a technical protocol create a new operating Plane?
anti_duplication: Domain records retain substantive identity and current facts.
Foundation records own generative chronology/reproduction, not the whole entity.
Timeline events are projections of foundation clocks, not new canonical foundation records.
Graph edges reference Foundation records; they do not duplicate their clock payloads.
Religious foundation records remain the canonical substantive religious-formation owners and can link to cross-domain Foundation records.
